name: Mitani Sekisan Co., Ltd.
summary: Mitani Sekisan Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells concrete products in Japan. It operates through three segments: Concrete Secondary Products-Related Business; Information-Related Business; and Others. The company offers concrete secondary products, such as concrete piles, poles, environmental products including block products, sand, gravel products, and wave-breaking block forms, and provides rental services for wave-breaking block formwork, environmental sanitation, facility management, business hotel management, real estate rental and solar power generation businesses.
